description: stablenet: 4 bp + 1 en. Binaries: default = gstable, upgrade = ${GSTABLE_UPGRADE_BIN:-gstable-hardfork}. The two names must name two files: a name is resolved on the target under one directory, so an upgrade that fell back to gstable would be the same executable and a swap onto it would measure nothing. The fallback is therefore a name nothing places by default — build the second go-stablenet, put it on the target as gstable-hardfork, or point GSTABLE_UPGRADE_BIN at it. Used by 1 case.
